name: Les Borges del Camp (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a light blue wavy band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged with two green huts (borges) at the upper fly and the lower hoist.
history: The flag is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, yellow, with a light blue wavy bend of two crests of thickness 1/6 of the height, placed from the upper hoist corner to the lower fly, with the two green borges of the arms of height 1/3 of the cloth.

features.role: wavy band of two crests from the upper hoist to the lower fly
two huts (borges) at the upper fly and the lower hoist
